input_contract: A Week 8 controlled answer together with its retrieval run ID, query ID, query year, and persisted corpus provenance.
required_checks: case citation resolves to an existing corpus chunk
displayed passage and provenance exactly match the corpus record
chunk was recorded in the retrieval run for this query
candidate is neither an exact target-case nor an audited near duplicate
candidate decision year is strictly earlier than the ILDC query year
answer_key_measurement: For test-split queries, reconcile expected authorities using the verified authority source ID, citation, or title plus exact decision date when the corpus stores a parallel reporter citation. Record retrieved-but-not-selected authorities separately from authorities absent from the retrieved candidates, and displayed citations that fail verification.
unsupported_citation_policy: The controlled E3 renderer emits corpus case citations only. Any citation without a linked evidence chunk, including an unsupported case-name field, is rejected; statutes or other source types are not silently treated as verified.
